title: Tiny, cute balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#ff9db0'/>
  <!-- small shine -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='3' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <!-- knot -->
  <path d='M50 66 L46 72 L54 72 Z' fill='#d63350'/>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50 72 Q44 82 52 92' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cute tiny face on balloon -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#3b0a16'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#3b0a16'/>
  <path d='M45 48 Q50 53 55 48' stroke='#3b0a16' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='47' r='2' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='47' r='2' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
</svg>
